bib.title: CMMLU: Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding in Chinese
bib.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2024

read.skipped: Reference list and per-subject Tables 7/10 and Fig 7-9 axis text skimmed only.

question: How well do current LLMs handle broad, knowledge-and-reasoning multiple-choice tasks in Mandarin Chinese and Chinese cultural context?
hypothesis: English-centred (translated) benchmarks are unsuitable for other cultures, so a native Chinese MMLU-style benchmark will expose gaps; LLMs are expected to struggle on China-specific and STEM subjects.
contributions: CMMLU: 67-subject Chinese multitask benchmark, with China-specific subjects
Evaluation of >20 LLMs from 12 families at 0-shot and 5-shot
Analysis of CoT, few-shot count, model size, negation and sub-option questions

method.summary: Four annotators collected multiple-choice exam-style questions (80%+ from OCR'd PDFs) across 67 subjects; >20 LLMs are scored zero- and five-shot, mostly by next-token logits over A-D, with free generation + regex for closed models and some analyses.

datasets.name: CMMLU
datasets.split: 5 dev questions per subject for few-shot, rest test (>100 per subject)
datasets.source: Hand-collected by 4 annotators from freely available resources, mock exams, quiz shows; >80% from PDFs after OCR; public redistributable sources
datasets.preprocessing: 50:50 mix of LaTeX and plain text for formulae; ~2% estimated label noise; overlap with C-Eval and M3KE about 1%

inference.decoding: Open models: highest logit among tokens A,B,C,D at the answer position (next token prediction). ChatGPT/GPT4 and analyses of Sec 4.2: free generation then regex extraction (Algorithm 1).
inference.samples: single run per model and setting; no seeds or variance reported
inference.prompting: Chinese instruction '以下是关于[主题]的单项选择题，请直接给出正确答案的选项' then question and choices, ending '答案是：'. 0-shot or up to 5 demonstrations; longest demonstrations dropped by sub-token count if context overflows. COT variant: '逐步分析并选出正确答案', zero-shot only.

parameters.strategies_compared: next token prediction, perplexity comparison (not run), free generation

metrics.name: accuracy
metrics.definition: fraction of correct answers; macro-average over subjects in a category, Overall macro-average over all subjects

eval.protocol: Single run, no significance test; Base vs Chat models; for models with both released, the better one is shown (*).

prompts.text: 以下是关于[主题]的单项选择题，请直接给出正确答案的选项。 (Here are some single-choice questions about [subject], please provide the correct answer choice directly.) 题目：... A. ... B. ... C. ... D. ... 答案是：
逐步分析并选出正确答案 (Analyze step by step and select the correct answer)

limits: Multiple-choice only, so fluency and generative reasoning are not assessed (authors).
Data contamination cannot be fully excluded (authors).
Single runs, no variance; evaluation of GPT4 and ChatGPT done at different dates (May and July 2023) and via free generation, so not directly comparable to logit scoring of open models.
Models are from 2023 and the leaderboard has dated.
Emergent-ability reading of LLaMA2 size jumps was explicitly not claimed (Appendix E).
Correlation with other benchmarks rests on 6 models.
